processes.title: Business function chart
processes.building: This screen is being built in Slice 1.
processes.subtitle: Five levels, coded automatically · each process step owns exactly one business requirement
processes.noChildOfProcess: A process step has no children.
processes.empty: No functions yet. Start with a level-1 function.
processes.reorderHelp: Move a function up or down among its siblings — every code below it is renumbered in one save.
processes.pickNode: Select a function in the hierarchy to see and edit it.
processes.notInTree: That function is not in the chart. It may be retired — turn on Show retired to see it.
processes.newLevel: The new function sits at level {n}. Its code is generated from the parent chain on save.
processes.addProcessHelp: A process step gets its business requirement at once. A level-5 function is always a process.
processes.codeHelp: Generated from the parent chain on save
processes.name: Function name
processes.processHelp: A process step owns one business requirement. Turning it off is refused while the step still has a live requirement, data, roles or parties.
processes.processLevels: A process sits at level 3, 4 or 5.
processes.promoted: Now a process step — requirement {br} created.
processes.retireBody: {name} is hidden from the chart. It can be restored from Show retired. A function with live children or a live requirement cannot be retired.
processes.staleAction: Someone else changed this first. It has been reloaded — try again.
processes.staleLink: Someone else changed this first. It has been reloaded — try again.
processes.stepFactsHelp: Data in and out, RACI roles and external parties belong to a process step. Mark this function as a process, or add them on its lowest sub-step.
processes.noEntities: There are no data entities yet.
processes.noParties: There are no external parties yet.
processes.noOrgRoles: There are no org roles yet.
processes.edgeOtherHelp: Leave empty for the start or end of the flow.
processes.edgeFixed: {from} → {to}. To join different steps, remove this flow and add a new one.
processes.conditionRequired: A conditional branch needs a condition, e.g. “Credit check failed”.
processes.conditionHandoff: For a hand-off with no next step, name who receives it.
processes.flowGapsHelp: Gaps in the flows of the steps under this node.
processes.gap.orphan_steps: Steps with no flow in or out
processes.gap.no_lane: Steps with no Responsible role (no swimlane)
processes.flowPageHelp: The steps under this node, in swimlanes by their Responsible role.
processes.flowCanvasHelp: Drag a box to place it; the position is saved. Drag from a box's blue dot onto another box to add a flow. Drag the end of an arrow onto another box to move it.
processes.flowNoSteps: There are no process steps under this node yet.
processes.resetLayoutBody: Every saved position on this diagram is removed and the boxes are arranged automatically. Flows and steps are not changed.
processes.addStepHelp: The step is added to the chart under this node, with its business requirement. Connect it by dragging from its right edge.
processes.edgeMove: Move this flow to {from} → {to}. The old flow is removed and this one added, keeping its type and condition.
